item.description: I hope this page will be a place where I can share my life and work. I will update it regularly with my latest news and updates. Just keep going! June 01 2026 | Tuned in to the OT+OPT Workshop online! Gained a lot of inspiring insights into the latest research in optimization and optimal transport.

item.title: Research Stories
item.description: How can optimization recover what the data cannot reveal directly? Two perspectives connect this question to statistical inference and the geometry of probability distributions. Optimization for statistical inference Recovering structure from limited data A useful estimator needs both statistical accuracy and computational efficiency. Ill-conditioning and high dimensionality make their interaction especially interesting. 01 Parameter estimation Observations reveal a system only indirectly. Recovering its hidden parameters calls for algorithms that remain reliable even when the objective is nonconvex or ill-conditioned.
